title: feat: dedicated /webhooks/stripe endpoint with HMAC verification
author: arjun.mehta
description:
Implements POST /webhooks/stripe endpoint (NEX-240).

This is the resolution to the Stripe webhook + rate limiter conflict (NEX-231, email_04). Approach approved by Priya Sharma in email_12: dedicated endpoint with HMAC verification instead of IP whitelisting.

Implementation:
- Verifies Stripe-Signature header using stripe.webhooks.constructEvent()
- Returns 200 immediately after signature verification
- Processes events asynchronously via Bull/Redis queue
- Handles: payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed, charge.refunded, charge.dispute.created
- All events written to payment_audit_log (NEX-219)
- Endpoint is explicitly excluded from rate limiter middleware (NEX-231)

Security: signature verification replaces IP-based trust. Even if Stripe's IP ranges change, only signed events from our Stripe account are accepted.

Related: NEX-240, NEX-231, NEX-204, NEX-219, email_04, email_12, docs/api-rate-limiting.md
